title: •••Death Star Gunner
caption: •••Death Star Gunner (V)
game_text: While on Death Star: cancels opponent’s game text on your non-docking bay Death Star sites, your {set:anh} Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to ▲ Superlaser.
lore: Most gunners in the Imperial Navy once aspired to be TIE pilots, but lacked sufficient skills to fly starfighters. A few were assigned to the Death Star to man the main artillery.

notes: Restricted (•••). Stats POWER 1 / ABILITY 1, third box blank; deploy 2 / forfeit 2. No column icons. Inline icon before 'Epic Event': green sphere with crossed red/white streaks = A New Hope (Death Star) set icon (matches set-anh-grainy.png) → {set:anh} (GEMP VB1: '[A New Hope] Epic Event'); the wiki stub drops it and expands ▲. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Imperial (Imperial disc). NOTE the slip reads 'cancels opponent’s game text on your non-docking bay Death Star sites'; GEMP's Virtual Block 1 legacy text reads 'cancels Force drain bonuses from Death Star sites’ game text' — transcribed as the slip prints. Lore matches the scan. Only a 350 px scan; copyright 1996 (ANH) by set. Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1 -pre, 350 px).
